findings.test: Scoped hook suites and submit flow
findings.evidence: Tests exercise real persisted stores and dialog callbacks. Cache sync verifies final persisted Submitted metadata and cleared current cache id; save/reset flows invoke their actual confirmation callbacks and inspect store state. Carousel model now checks persisted box and absence state after actions; the prior status assertion observed a stale hook snapshot. Camera test uses the actual PermissionStatus enum while replacing the unusable native Asset boundary.
findings.changes: Fixed the carousel assertions to read persisted annotation state. Replaced the expo-media-library requireActual spread in the camera test with the actual expo-modules-core PermissionStatus enum because loading the SDK source failed from its native superclass; kept Asset and permission operations at the test boundary.
